newsitem.title: FRANCE: Empty French TGV train derailed, no casualties.
newsitem.headline: Empty French TGV train derailed, no casualties.

text.p: An empty TGV high-speed train was derailed in the southwestern French town of Hendaye on Wednesday, causing damage but no casualties, the SNCF state railway said.

A spokesman for the regional SNCF management said a points error caused the accident. The train was routed to a depot where it crashed into several machines instead of being put on the northbound track through Hendaye station to Bordeaux.
The accident did not disrupt traffic.
On Sunday, an Italian high-speed "Pendolino" train derailed on the Milan-Rome line, killing eight people on board. The cause has not yet been determined.
